propositions: run_git_write does not retry write-side temp-file faults (ENOENT/EINVAL) because _with_transient_head_retry only matches READ-side markers like 'could not parse head' and 'bad object'

event_append privately defines _TRANSIENT_ADD_MARKERS matching the same write-side fault signatures and retries them, but this protection does not apply to s3_doctor, compaction, or transition writers that use the shared run_git_write seam
Duplicate marker families must be consolidated into a single definition in gitutil so all callers of run_git_write inherit bounded write-side fault retry
Corrupt-object signatures like 'loose object is corrupt' must remain excluded from retry to prevent masking genuine data faults
Nested composition of read-side and write-side retry loops accidentally grants commit-path operations up to 9 attempts instead of the intended bounded 3
